title: Quotient SNF Invariant Runner
certificate_policy: complete torsion-free certificate only if SNF backend returns complete_snf; otherwise exact rank plus sampled modular agreement is reported
architecture_upgrade: CCCLXXVII built the exact quotient relation matrix. CCCLXXX runs the invariant-factor path when available and otherwise emits a clear rank-plus-modular fallback certificate.
theorem: The H1 quotient relation matrix R has rank 120 and free rank 81. If SNF computes with all nonzero invariant factors equal to 1, this proves the quotient is torsion-free. Otherwise the runner records the exact rank and sampled modular agreement as a fallback audit.
honesty_boundary: A complete torsion-free certificate is claimed only when certificate_type is complete_snf. Otherwise the output remains a transparent partial invariant audit.
